title: Media Flow Planner
description: Implement a PURE, side-effect-free scheduling function `plan_media_flow` (Rust, in framework/product/os/core/rs/lib.rs) plus its TypeScript twin `planMediaFlow` (in framework/product/os/core/js/index.ts) for the S/Semios media graph dataflow. Given an OsMediaGraph and a set of dirty instance ids, compute the downstream closure of dirty instances by walking graph edges, emitting one MediaFlowDelivery per traversed edge, propagating dirtiness to consumer instances so multi-hop chains resolve in one pass, in topological order. Add Rust unit tests (single edge, chain, diamond, no-op, dead-end) and a Rust<->TS parity fixture set + tests on both sides. Do NOT wire this into any live driver/UI (that's a later ticket) - planner + parity tests only. Must not touch OsMediaGraphEdge struct definition or s/plugin/rs/lib.rs connect handlers (owned by concurrent sibling ticket R1b).
